Title: Revoked or disabled staff keep access for up to an hour on 25 endpoints that have no static permission
Evidence: functions/lib/callable.js:73-79 calls assertSessionStillValid only when options.permission is set. Endpoints with auth 'required' and no static permission (registry listing): analyticsReport, analyticsExport, listReportConfigs, reportInbox, reportRun, hrReport, getHrSettings, getPayslip, hrMyProfile, myAttendance, myLeave, myAdvances, myPayslips, applyLeave, cancelLeave, leaveBalance, listHolidays, requestAdvance, cancelAdvance (plus customer endpoints placeOrder, cancelMyOrder, submitReview, quoteCheckout, claimOwner)
Recommended fix: Run assertSessionStillValid for every authenticated staff call (or when token.staff is true) in runEndpoint
Verification test required: Emulator test: disable a staff user, then call analyticsReport/hrReport/getPayslip with the still-valid token and expect an error

Title: Employee CNIC scans and expense receipts are stored as PUBLIC blobs
Evidence: src/admin/hrUi.js uploadHrFile and src/admin/financeUi.js uploadReceipt call upload(..., { access: 'public' }); anyone holding a document URL can open it; removing the record in Firestore does not delete the file (functions/services/hr.js removeDocument only deletes the Firestore row); Vercel Blob URL contains a random suffix but is not access controlled
Recommended fix: Store sensitive documents behind an authenticated download (server fetches the blob with the token) or private storage; delete the blob when the record is removed; do not store CNIC images until fixed
Verification test required: Unauthenticated GET of a stored document URL must fail
